scenarios.name: Maximize and restore using the application bar

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/main-window-frame-start.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part document is active in the MCAD Software
the restored main window occupies a known size and position within the desktop work area
the user selects Maximize in the application bar
the window fills the monitor's work area and respects the taskbar
Restore replaces Maximize in the same position
the ribbon and viewport lay out within the enlarged window
the user selects Restore in the application bar
the window returns to its previous size and position
Maximize replaces Restore in the same position
